svg.title: Reading Shelf milestone 1: capture and track reading
svg.desc: Six-perspective overview. Green marks new subjects: the reader’s intentions, the link and annotation rules, the page script, Articles API, Library store, Articles JSON API, articles table, and four new checks. Blue marks changed subjects: the library page, Flask app, SQLite library, and app factory. Gray marks context: the source website and the existing starter-file check.
svg.text: Reading Shelf milestone 1: capture and track reading
Proposed full-stack change • A Flask JSON API keeps each article’s link, title, note, and status in SQLite.
